title: Our Team
intro: Meet the people who lead the hub, support entrepreneurs and build the YERH platform.

groupPhoto.alt: Members of the YERH team in Eldoret

members.name: Dr. Abraham Rotich
members.bio: Dr. Rotich leads KCA University’s work to empower young entrepreneurs through innovation. He connects university initiatives with industry partners and guides YERH’s alignment with Kenya’s economic priorities and international partnerships.

members.name: Alexander Njuguna Kamau
members.positioning: Lead Project Manager & Student Engagement Director
members.bio: Alexander manages YERH’s delivery, tracks project milestones and oversees grant requirements. He supervises how the Student Engagement Program fits into the university’s incubation centre.

members.name: Patience Githinji
members.bio: Patience manages the incubation centre’s activity records and coordinates with student development teams. She helps keep the hub’s on-site work and online activities in sync.

members.name: Anthony Ochieng
members.bio: Anthony connects entrepreneurs and partners across the YERH network. He brings feedback and priorities from young entrepreneurs into the planning of hub initiatives.

members.name: Sam Moturi
members.bio: Sam leads development sprints, reviews proposed code and oversees merges. His work helps the team maintain the platform’s architecture, security and ability to grow.

members.name: Feiswal Dindi Onyango
members.positioning: Front-End Lead Engineer & Product Lead Manager
members.bio: Feiswal turns student needs into product and interface improvements. He works with Vue, React and Laravel on YERH’s core interface, marketplace storefronts and homepage.

members.name: Stephen Macharia
members.bio: Stephen develops YERH’s learning tools. His work includes virtual incubation modules, course layouts and automated verification for entrepreneurs using the platform.

members.name: Andrew
members.bio: Andrew maintains the project’s repository infrastructure and works on sign-in and account access. He helps protect user data and maintain the platform’s role permissions.
